entries.question: What is Studiely?
entries.answer: Studiely is an AI-powered learning platform designed to help students understand concepts, revise effectively, and prepare for assessments across multiple international curricula using smart study tools.

entries.question: Who is Studiely for?
entries.answer: Studiely is designed for students studying under British, IB, American, Canadian, and Australian curricula.

entries.question: Is Studiely free?
entries.answer: Yes. Studiely offers a free Starter plan with limited monthly generations so students can explore the platform before upgrading.

entries.question: Do I need a teacher to use Studiely?
entries.answer: No. Studiely is fully self-guided and can be used independently by students.

entries.question: Which devices are supported?
entries.answer: Studiely works on web browsers and mobile devices (Android and iOS).

entries.question: Is Studiely available on web and mobile?
entries.answer: Yes. You can access Studiely on the web and through our mobile applications.

entries.question: How do I create an account?
entries.answer: You can sign up using your email address and create a secure password directly in the app or on the website.

entries.question: Can I use Studiely without signing up?
entries.answer: No. An account is required to save progress, manage generations, and ensure data security.

entries.question: How do I change my password?
entries.answer: Go to Profile → Account Settings → Change Password and follow the instructions.

entries.question: I forgot my password — what do I do?
entries.answer: Use the "Forgot Password" option on the login screen to reset your password via email.

entries.question: Can I delete my account?
entries.answer: Yes. You can request account deletion through the Account Deletion page listed in our Help Center.

entries.question: What happens to my data if I delete my account?
entries.answer: All personal data and generated content associated with your account are permanently deleted in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

entries.question: Which curricula does Studiely support?
entries.answer:
Studiely supports:
· British (IGCSE / GCSE)
· IB (PYP, MYP, DP)
· American
· Canadian
· Australian

entries.question: Which grades and year levels are covered?
entries.answer: Coverage varies by curriculum and subject, following official syllabus structures.

entries.question: Can I switch between curricula?
entries.answer: Yes. You can change your curriculum selection at any time from the settings or generation screen.

entries.question: Is content aligned with official exam boards?
entries.answer: Yes. Content is aligned with official curriculum frameworks and exam board expectations.

entries.question: Does Studiely support IGCSE exam preparation?
entries.answer: Yes. Studiely includes exam-focused tools specifically designed for IGCSE and similar exam-based curricula.

entries.question: Does Studiely support IB (PYP / MYP / DP)?
entries.answer:
Yes. Studiely follows IB philosophy strictly:
· PYP focuses on conceptual understanding (no exams)
· MYP and DP include assessment-aligned content where appropriate

entries.question: Why are exam-style questions disabled for PYP?
entries.answer: IB PYP does not have formal examinations. Studiely respects IB philosophy and avoids exam-focused content where it is not appropriate.

entries.question: Can I study multiple subjects at once?
entries.answer: Yes. You can generate content for different subjects and topics as needed.

entries.question: Summary Notes: What are Summary Notes?
entries.answer: Clear, structured explanations of key concepts, definitions, and formulas for quick understanding.

entries.question: Summary Notes: How long are the notes?
entries.answer: Length varies by plan, ranging from 250 to 600 words.

entries.question: Summary Notes: Are they exam-oriented or concept-based?
entries.answer: They are concept-first, with exam relevance added where appropriate.

entries.question: Summary Notes: Can I regenerate notes?
entries.answer: Yes. You can regenerate content to improve clarity or depth.

entries.question: Summary Notes: Can I export notes as PDF?
entries.answer: Yes. PDF and printable exports are available.

entries.question: Summary Notes: Are notes plagiarism-free?
entries.answer: Yes. All content is original and AI-generated uniquely for each request.

entries.question: Flashcards: How do flashcards work?
entries.answer: They present bite-sized questions and answers to support memorisation and revision.

entries.question: Flashcards: How many flashcards are generated?
entries.answer: Between 10–30 depending on your plan.

entries.question: Flashcards: Are flashcards downloadable?
entries.answer: Yes, including Anki-compatible formats (Pro plan).

entries.question: Quiz: Are quizzes exam-style?
entries.answer: Yes, for exam-based curricula. PYP quizzes focus on understanding, not exams.

entries.question: Quiz: Do quizzes include answers?
entries.answer: Yes, with instant feedback and explanations.

entries.question: Quiz: Can I retake quizzes?
entries.answer: Yes. You can regenerate or retry quizzes anytime.

entries.question: Quiz: How is difficulty decided?
entries.answer: Based on your selected difficulty level and curriculum standards.

entries.question: Exam Focus (Pro Only): What is Exam Focus?
entries.answer: A breakdown of how a topic appears in exams and how marks are awarded.

entries.question: Exam Focus: Which exams does it cover?
entries.answer: Primarily IGCSE, GCSE, MYP, DP, and equivalent systems.

entries.question: Exam Focus: Why is it not available for all curricula?
entries.answer: Some curricula do not use formal exams.

entries.question: Common Mistakes: What kind of mistakes are shown?
entries.answer: Frequent student errors and misconceptions related to the topic.

entries.question: Common Mistakes: Are these based on real exams?
entries.answer: They are informed by common examiner observations and student patterns.

entries.question: Worked Examples: Are solutions step-by-step?
entries.answer: Yes. Each example shows a clear method from start to finish.

entries.question: Worked Examples: Do examples include marking guidance?
entries.answer: Yes, where exam marking is applicable.

entries.question: How does Studiely generate content?
entries.answer: Studiely uses advanced AI models guided by curriculum-specific rules and prompts.

entries.question: Is AI content accurate?
entries.answer: Content is designed to be curriculum-aligned and educationally sound. You can regenerate or refine outputs anytime.

entries.question: Why do outputs differ sometimes?
entries.answer: AI adapts to your inputs, difficulty level, and curriculum selection.

entries.question: Can I control difficulty level?
entries.answer: Yes. You can choose beginner, intermediate, or advanced levels.

title: E. Usage Limits & Fair Usage Policy

entries.question: What does "50 generations per month" mean?
entries.answer: Each time you generate notes, quizzes, or other tools counts as one generation.

entries.question: Do regenerations count?
entries.answer: Yes. Each regeneration counts as a new generation.

entries.question: How much does Studiely cost?
entries.answer: Studiely offers Free and Pro plans with monthly, quarterly, biannual, and yearly options.

entries.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
entries.answer: Yes. You can cancel anytime through your app store or account settings.

entries.question: Will I be charged automatically?
entries.answer: Yes. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled.

entries.question: Are refunds available?
entries.answer: Refunds are handled according to platform policies (Google Play, Apple App Store, or Web).

entries.question: Is my data safe?
entries.answer: Yes. Studiely follows strict data protection and security practices.

entries.question: Does Studiely share my data?
entries.answer: No personal data is sold or shared without consent.

entries.question: Where can I read the Privacy Policy?
entries.answer: The Privacy Policy is available in the Help Center and website footer.

entries.question: How do I request account deletion?
entries.answer: Use the Account Deletion Request page linked in the Help Center.

entries.question: Content is not generating — what should I do?
entries.answer: Check your internet connection and retry. If the issue persists, contact support.

entries.question: How do I report a bug?
entries.answer: Use the support chat or contact form in the Help Center.

entries.question: How do I contact support?
entries.answer: Pro users can chat instantly. Free users can submit a support request form.

entries.question: Can I talk to a real person?
entries.answer: Yes. Human support is available for complex or account-related issues.

entries.question: How fast does support respond?
entries.answer: AI responses are instant. Human response times vary based on availability.

entries.question: Will teacher features be added?
entries.answer: Yes. Teacher tools are planned for future releases.
